# Feature: Performance Tracking

## Overview
Create a comprehensive performance monitoring system that tracks staff metrics, service quality, and customer satisfaction.

## User Stories

1. Metric Tracking
   - As a business owner
   - I want to track key staff performance metrics
   - So I can evaluate staff effectiveness

2. Service Quality
   - As a manager
   - I want to monitor service quality metrics
   - So we can maintain high standards

3. Customer Feedback
   - As a service provider
   - I want to see customer feedback
   - So I can improve my service

4. Goal Management
   - As a manager
   - I want to set and track performance goals
   - So staff have clear targets

5. Performance Reviews
   - As a business owner
   - I want to conduct performance reviews
   - So we can provide structured feedback

## Technical Tasks
- [ ] Create metrics tracking system
- [ ] Implement quality monitoring
- [ ] Build feedback collection
- [ ] Create goal management
- [ ] Implement review system
- [ ] Add performance dashboards
- [ ] Create comparison tools
- [ ] Implement trend analysis
- [ ] Add performance alerts
- [ ] Create reporting system

## Acceptance Criteria
- Metrics track accurately
- Quality scores calculate properly
- Feedback collects reliably
- Goals track effectively
- Reviews process properly
- Dashboards update real-time
- Comparisons work correctly
- Reports generate accurately

## Technical Notes
- Use analytics engine
- Implement proper metrics
- Use background jobs for analysis
- Cache performance data
- Follow SOLID principles
- Implement proper logging

## Estimate
- Story Points: 13
- Time Estimate: 1.5 weeks

## Dependencies
- Schedule Management feature
- Service Assignment feature
